reports.title: EMCOR GROUP, INC. REPORTS RECORD THIRD QUARTER 2026 RESULTS

guidance.heading: Full-Year 2026 Guidance
section: Based on the momentum the Company has experienced year-to-date, along with near-term visibility, EMCOR now expects the following for full year 2026:

Current Guidance (10/29/26) | Previous Guidance (7/30/26)
Revenues | $20.6 billion – $21.0 billion | $20.0 billion – $20.5 billion
Non-GAAP Operating Margin* | ~10% | 9.5% – 9.8%
Non-GAAP Diluted EPS* | $34.50 – $35.50 | $32.00 – $33.25
* Excludes impairment loss on identifiable intangible assets.
